programme_context.prescribed_first_artifact: glossary and obstruction ledger before formal construction

answer: Topos-internal quantum theory, constructive localic Gelfand duality, and synthetic differential geometry provide adjacent translations for logic, spectra, algebraic systems, and formal manifolds. They do not compose automatically into a Weyl-gravity BV theory. The finite local BV identities are the lowest-risk internalization candidate, while distribution theory, microlocal control, causal Green operators, indefinite completion, state semantics, renormalized products, and the QME require separate constructions in a selected topos. This V0 artifact records the interfaces and blocks promotion before those choices are made.
ambient_choices_required: a specific elementary, Grothendieck, realizability, or smooth topos
its internal number objects and logic
any synthetic differential-geometric axioms used for spacetime
the external metatheory in which certificates and content hashes are checked

glossary.warning: Excluded middle and choice do not transfer automatically.

glossary.topos_candidate: object, subobject, and generalized truth value
glossary.warning: External global elements need not detect internal equality or existence.
Point-free spectrum does not imply a finite spectrum or enough points.

glossary.ordinary_term: C*-algebra of observables on a Hilbert space
glossary.topos_candidate: internal commutative algebra assembled from classical contexts
glossary.warning: This does not supply a field net, dynamics, or interacting Weyl algebra.

glossary.topos_candidate: formal manifold or synthetic smooth object in a chosen smooth topos
glossary.warning: The cited bridge concerns synthetic differential geometry and classical GR, not a Lorentzian gauge QFT.

glossary.ordinary_term: section of a vector or graded bundle
glossary.topos_candidate: internal section of an internal bundle or sheaf
glossary.warning: Function spaces, support, and topology must be constructed, not inferred from notation.

glossary.ordinary_term: graded-commutative algebra with differential, bracket, and pairing
glossary.topos_candidate: internal graded algebra object with structure morphisms and equations
glossary.warning: Only fixed finite algebraic identities are presently plausible imports; no internal Weyl BV complex is built.

glossary.topos_candidate: internal differential operator defined using the selected smooth structure
glossary.warning: Order, symbols, domains, and formal adjoints depend on the ambient smooth and integration structures.

glossary.topos_candidate: internal locally convex or sheaf-theoretic test object and an appropriate dual
glossary.warning: No nuclear topology, distribution duality, or wavefront-set calculus has been imported.

glossary.ordinary_term: retarded/advanced Green operator with causal support
glossary.topos_candidate: internal solution morphism plus an internalized causal-support relation
glossary.warning: Global hyperbolicity, energy estimates, uniqueness, and support propagation each require independent meaning and proof.

glossary.topos_candidate: internal indefinite module or Hilbert object with a specified symmetry and completion notion
glossary.warning: The explicit ZF construction is external and does not itself yield an internal completion.

glossary.ordinary_term: positive normalized functional and Born probabilities
glossary.topos_candidate: internal state, valuation, or probability valuation on a locale
glossary.warning: Logical reformulation does not select a physical state or an empirical interpretation.

glossary.ordinary_term: kernel modulo image of a BRST differential
glossary.topos_candidate: internal cohomology object, with any external global-section comparison stated separately
glossary.warning: Internal exactness and externally observed cohomology need not coincide without comparison theorems.

glossary.ordinary_term: renormalized time-ordered products and quantum master equation
glossary.topos_candidate: internal renormalization data and QME morphism/equality in a specified model
glossary.warning: No such construction or anomaly classification follows from localic spectra or synthetic smoothness.

glossary.ordinary_term: files, hashes, verifier commands, and repository commits
glossary.topos_candidate: external metatheoretic evidence about a formalization
glossary.warning: A content hash is not automatically an internal proposition or proof object.

obstructions.deliverable: Choose the ambient topos, internal logic, number objects, and external metatheory.
Construct the spacetime, conformal metric, bundles, differential operators, orientation, integration, and causal order internally.
Internalize a finite certified BV fragment and prove its algebraic identities as internal equalities.
Relate internal kernels, images, quotients, and cohomology objects to the externally certified residual classes.
Construct test sections, support, topology/completion, distributions, and continuous duals.
Define singular support or wavefront data and prove the operations needed for products and parametrices.
Prove existence, uniqueness, continuity, adjoint duality, and causal support for the required Green operators.
Construct the indefinite carrier, fundamental symmetry, completion, domains, and BRST-compatible pairing internally.
Define state/probability semantics and construct a physically selected BRST-compatible state.
Construct local covariant renormalized time-ordered products with declared comparison semantics.
Classify anomalies and counterterms and restore the local quantum master equation internally.
Prove a sound external comparison theorem identifying which physical predictions and certified classes are preserved.

lowest_risk_candidate.reason: It uses a fixed finite presentation and equations, avoiding completion, support, measure, causality, and microlocal analysis.

source_dependencies.use: synthetic differential-geometric route to intuitionistic classical GR

does_not_establish: a formalized topos-internal Weyl-gravity BV complex
that every ordinary Weyl-gravity construction internalizes in an arbitrary topos
a constructive theory of distributions or wavefront sets
internal retarded or advanced Green operators
a topos-internal Krein or Hilbert completion
a physical state-selection or Born-rule theorem
restoration of the quantum master equation
equivalence with the repository's external classical or quantum theory
next_gate: Select one ambient topos and internalize only the fixed finite BV presentation O3, retaining an external/internal comparison ledger; do not start with continuum Green or QME claims.
